title: DID Management — Account Policy Set — payload
description: An administrator sets one hosting domain's self-registration terms — opening or closing it, choosing which authorising parties' vouchers admit a registrant, and the limits — taking effect at once, with no restart. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

Response.title: DID Management — Account Policy Set — response payload
Response.description: The terms the domain now applies. Failures use trust-task-error, not this shape.

changed.description: `false` when the domain already applied exactly these terms.
